title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2018
ACT III OF 2018
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Local Government Act, 2013
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary, 23rd
February, 2018]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills / 2018 / 4151, dated
23.2.2018.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government
(Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 13th February, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 20th February, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Act,
2013 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXVIII of 2013), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follow:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(I) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government (Amendment) Act,
2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 35 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXVIII of 2013

ACT III OF 2018

[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary, 23rd
February, 2018]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills / 2018 / 4151, dated
23.2.2018.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government
(Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 13th February, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 20th February, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Act,
2013 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXVIII of 2013), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follow:
2. Amendment
of section 35 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXVIII of 2013.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local Government Act,
2013 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXVIII of 2013), in section 35, after
subsection (4), the following now subsection shall be inserted, namely:
"(4A)
Where the local council or local government, as the case may be, does not exist
due to non-election, Government may, by notification in the official Gazette,
authorize the Deputy Commissioner, Assistant Commissioner or Assistant
Director, Local Government, Elections and Rural Development Department, at the
level of concerned district, tehsil or village council/neighbourhood council,
respectively, to perform the functions, relating to the utilization of the
budget within its respective jurisdiction as per parameters, specified in the
Planning and Development Guidelines, for the time being in force."
